title: Compliance spindle notes — attestation sprint (Ezra)
content:
Purpose: quick brain-dump for the upcoming SOC2 attestation sprint. Treat this as my messy working canvas — prioritize clarifying gaps and owners, then tidy into the sprint doc.

High-level goals:
- Get an actionable inventory of evidence we can ship to the auditor within 3 weeks.
- Identify 2–3 high-risk control gaps that need remediation vs compensating controls.
- Draft owner assignments for evidence collection (who pulls logs, who runs config export, who signs off).

Things I keep tripping on (questions):
1) KMS key usage lineage: do we have a single map from service -> KMS key id -> rotation policy? I remember a half-table in platform-engineering Confluence but not complete. Auditor will want rotation proof + access list. Where to pull `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` outputs automatically?
2) Backup verification cadence: backups exist across DB clusters (prod+staging). Do we have automated restore tests recorded anywhere? If not, we should create a one-off restore run and record video + log outputs.
3) Access reviews: engineering org chart has frequent churn. Which teams have been through a documented 2025–2026 access review? Need list with timestamps.
4) Third-party SOC reports: SSO provider, logging provider — do we have PDFs and scope notes in a single place? Possibly SSO vendor says scope does not include token exchange; need to capture that as a residual risk.

Control mapping draft (very rough) — format: CONTROL_ID : short description -> tentative evidence -> owner (team) -> confidence
- C-PRI-1 : API key lifecycle policy -> README + key rotation logs (last 6 mo) -> eng-platform -> low (missing automated rotation proof)
- C-PRI-2 : KMS access control -> key IAM export + admin list -> security -> medium (need consolidated export)
- C-OPS-3 : Backup integrity -> snapshot catalog + restore run video -> infra -> low (no recorded restore)
- C-NET-4 : Network segmentation -> VPC peering diagram + firewall rules export -> infra-network -> medium
- C-APP-5 : Deployment change control -> PR gating logs + rollout audit trail -> release-engineering -> high

Evidence candidates to collect (immediate):
- KMS: IAM policy exports, rotation timestamps, key creation metadata (KMS console/CLI).
- Logging: retention settings for syslogs/app logs, S3 bucket policy exports, access logs for the buckets.
- Backups: snapshot manifests, restore logs, retention policy doc.
- ACLs: terraform state snippets + last apply diff.
- Oncall: escalation matrix doc + pager duty schedule screenshots for last 6 months.
- Training: last security training roster (HR) + certificates for new hires in 2025–2026.

Quick evidence collection plan (two-week sprint):
Week 1:
- Triage evidence list and assign owners (day 1)
- Collect KMS IAM exports (Rina)
- Pull logging retention configs and bucket access logs (Omar)
- Draft backup restore run checklist and schedule (Ezra + infra)
Week 2:
- Run one restore and record (infra)
- Consolidate PR gating logs (release-engineering)
action_items: Create KMS key inventory script (owner: Rina)
Schedule backup restore run with infra (owner: Omar)
Export terraform state snippets for ACLs (owner: Ezra)
Find vendor SOC reports and drop in shared folder (owner: Ezra)
Draft concise evidence index for auditor (owner: Rina)
